collect.says: A form of this collection, online, for anyone with its link to fill in. Each reply comes here as a row.
collect.hint: A field for each column you tick. The others stay yours.
collect.sent: Thank you. Your reply was sent.
collect.unsent: It couldn’t be sent. Try again.
collect.sealed: A reply is sealed in the visitor’s browser, so the host can’t read it.
